$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; tracks design/spec/safety-case-v0.1.md and design/adr/0095-evidence-grounded-safety-case-and-admissible-evidence.md. A Claims-Arguments-Evidence (CAE) tree auto-assembled from existing NovaFabric artifacts. Carried INSIDE an Evidence Bundle as safety-case.json + attestations/safety-case.intoto.json; NOT a third top-level format (ADR-0034). Core invariant I1: eval evidence MUST carry process evidence; a bare pass/fail is a schema violation.
title: SafetyCase
description: An Evidence-Grounded Safety Case: a CAE tree (Claim -> ArgumentStrategy -> Claim*|Evidence*) whose leaves bind to real NovaFabric artifacts. Backing states are assigned mechanically from evidence statistics so honesty is structural, not editorial.

schema_version.description: Safety-case schema version. Must be 0.1.x for this revision (ADR-0095).

template_id.description: The CAE skeleton the case was compiled from.

subject.description: What the case is about: a single run or a run-capsule set.

top_claim_id.description: id of the root Claim node in nodes[].

nodes.description: Flat node list. The tree is reconstructed via Claim.children and Claim.evidence_ids. Discriminated on node_type.

residual_risk.description: Defaults to not-quantified/null. NEVER reproduces disavowed literature sketch numbers as measurements.

case_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical (JCS) case serialization; the in-toto subject digest.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

kind.description: Single run or a set of runs.

run_ids.description: One or more run_ids covered by the case.

capsule_hash.description: Capsule Merkle root (single run) or set digest (run set).

id.description: Node id, unique within the case.

backing_state.description: Assigned mechanically from evidence statistics (ADR-0095 backing-state rules).

children.description: Child ArgumentStrategy/Claim node ids. May be empty for a leaf claim.

evidence_ids.description: Directly-supporting Evidence node ids. May be empty.

contest_reason.description: Why a claim is CONTESTED; null otherwise.

strategy.description: How the children support the parent.

inference_type.description: Exact replay match -> deductive; semantic-match -> inductive.

defeaters.description: Conditions that would undermine the inference.

evidence_kind.description: energy_receipt and replay_attestation are enum members so ADR-0093/ADR-0094 compose in with zero schema change.

path_in_bundle.description: Path within the Evidence Bundle, or null if external.

external_id.description: External identifier (e.g. Rekor index), or null.

sha256.description: Digest a verifier recomputes against the bundle manifest.

eval_context.description: REQUIRED (non-null) when evidence_kind is eval_result or judge_aggregate; null otherwise. Enforced by the conditional below (invariant I1).

attestation_ref.description: Path to the covering in-toto envelope, or null.

allOf.$comment: Invariant I1 - no naked claims: eval evidence MUST carry a non-null eval_context with a process_evidence_ref. A bare pass/fail is a schema VIOLATION.

judges.description: Judge identities/models that scored the result.

inter_judge_agreement.description: Inter-judge agreement statistic (e.g. kappa); null for a single judge. kappa < 0.6 forces the parent claim to CONTESTED.

consensus_verdict.description: The agreed verdict (or the lone judge's).

sample_size.description: n the score was computed over, or null.

confidence_interval.description: e.g. a Wilson interval on the pass rate. Straddling the threshold forces CONTESTED.

process_evidence_ref.description: REQUIRED ref to what the agent did (trace/tool-calls fact). This is the field that makes a score meaningful; its absence is the naked-claim violation.

value.description: Quantified residual risk; null unless basis is 'measured'.

basis.description: Provenance of the residual-risk figure. Defaults to not-quantified. 'disavowed-sketch' tags literature toy numbers that MUST NOT be presented as measurements.

caveat.description: Honest caveat; for disavowed-sketch, names the toy source.
